The FSR also carries the roster of right-wing leaders shared with France (Macron, Wauquiez, Bardella, Burkhard, de Villiers, Napoléon, Zemmour, Poisson).

sections.title: FSR Focus Tree: The French Socialist Republic
sections.body:
A short tree that settles which current takes over the revolution.

**Trunk.** *The French Socialist Republic* (+100 PP, +5% stability, a Garde Rouge division) → *Rebuild the Apparatus*, *Nationalise the Commanding Heights* (two civilian factories, industry research bonus) and *Raise the People's Army* (+30,000 manpower, +25 army experience, another Garde Rouge division) → *The First Congress*.

After the Congress the player picks one of four mutually exclusive currents. Each one has three steps, a final focus that sets the ruling party and suspends elections, and a closing focus (+10% stability, +10% war support, +200 PP, +40 army experience).

| Current | Steps | Takes power with | New ruling ideology |
|---|---|---|---|
| INTERNATIONALISTE (Communist Struggle) | Democratic Centralism → The Formation of Cadres | All Power to The Soviets → The International Is the Party | Vanguard Socialism |
| PCR (Parti communiste révolutionnaire) | The Factory Councils → Permanent Revolution | All Power to The Revolution → A Revolution Without End | Revolutionary Socialism |
| PCM | The Party School → The Politburo | All Power to The Party → A Party With a State | Totalitarian Socialism |
| Comité Central | The Ministries Keep Their Files → No Second Congress | All Power to The Committee → The Republic as It Stands | Authoritarian Socialism |

sections.title: Focus Tree: The 2025 Elections
sections.body:
**Start.** *The New Year* → *Remove the Strikes* (removes *The January Strikes*) → *Stagnate the Economy* → *Announce the New Candidates*. Then one of two mutually exclusive focuses replaces the whole tree:

- *The 2025 Elections* fires *The Presidential Election* and loads the **elections tree**.
- *Screw the Elections* fires the super event *The 2nd Romanian Revolution* and loads the **uprising tree**.

sections.title: Elections Tree
sections.body:
| Branch | Key focuses | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Nicusor Dan | Nicusor Victory → A Nation of Tradition / Reform the Government / Euro-Atlantic Anchor → Moldova and Ukraine | *The Conservative State of Romania* (Conservative), *Three Seas Alliance*, *Guardian of the Black Sea* |
| George Simion | Simion's Victory → Release Calin Georgescu → Implement a Nationalist Idea → Pact of Sovereign Nations, Claim the Lost Lands | *Go Full Fascism* (Ultranationalism), *Greater Romania* |
| Crin Antonescu | Victory for Antonescu → Stick With Socialism or Turn Back to Communism | *The Socialist State of Romania*: Progressive, or Vanguard Socialism on the communist branch; *Beacon of the Balkans* |
| Shared | Army Reform Command, Air Force Modernisation, Naval Modernisation, economy | *The Romanian Great Power* |

sections.title: Uprising Tree
sections.body:
| Path | First focus | Final focus |
|---|---|---|
| Monarchy | Bring Back the Monarchy (*The Crown Restored*) | *One Crown, One Nation*: +10% stability, +10% war support, +10% political power |
| Military rule | A Military Rule (*Military Junta*) | *The Iron Marshals*: +10% war support, +10% organisation, +10% political power, −5% stability |
| Orthodox state | The Orthodox State | *Holy Romania*: +10% stability, +10% war support, +10% political power |

The uprising paths do not change the ruling party yet; they work through national spirits.
